title: Jetbrains - SDK Update (v2025.3) / Fix terminal integration
author: catrielmuller
lessons: JetBrains SDK migrations can break fundamental assumptions like synchronous process creation
Reflection-based field replacement is necessary evil for IDE plugins but needs version-pinned tests
Supporting both OSC 633 and OSC 133 protocols ensures cross-version compatibility
Environment variable markers are a clean coordination mechanism for extension-owned terminals
Use actual logging framework levels, not text conventions like [DEBUG] prefix on info-level logs

test_results.local_test: not_run (JetBrains IDE with SDK 2025.3 required for manual testing)
